Restorative · Patient guide

Complete dentures in Gujranwala

A complete denture is a removable appliance that replaces all the teeth in an upper or lower arch.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Ask about replacement options when all teeth in an arch are missing, or if an older denture no longer fits well. Some patients may benefit from a different design.

What age group is it for?

Dentures are primarily planned for adults. Suitability depends on the teeth remaining, the health of the gums and how the appliance will be supported.

What happens at the appointment?

Impressions and bite records guide the design. You may have a trial fitting before receiving the finished denture, followed by adjustments.

Does it hurt?

Impressions may feel unfamiliar. New dentures can rub at first. Ask for an adjustment if soreness persists or affects eating.

How much does it cost?

Ask whether the estimate covers one arch or both, trial appointments, and adjustment visits after delivery.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
